title: IVG Intense Salts Pink Lemonade 10ml Nic Salts E-Liquid
description: IVG Intense Salts Pink Lemonade mixes the sweetness of ripe Strawberries with the tang of juicy Raspberries, finished with the sparkle of Lemonade. The result is a lively fruit soda profile that’s refreshing and satisfyingly sweet. Blended at 50VG/50PG, this Nic Salt e-liquid delivers consistent flavour, discreet vapour, and a tactile yet comfortable throat hit. Available in 10mg and 20mg strengths, Pink Lemonade is perfect for mouth-to-lung (MTL) devices such as pod kits, vape pens and starter systems. Part of the IVG Intense Salts range, Pink Lemonade captures a classic fruit soda character for everyday vaping.
